tools.name: ash_read
tools.description: Read a file or byte/line range; UTF-8 as-is, binary base64-encoded.

absolute.description: Emit absolute paths instead of repo-root-relative.

bytes.description: Max bytes to return; hard cap 8 MiB.

meta.description: Include encoding and mtime in the pretty header.

range.description: start:end range, 1-based inclusive; end clamped to file length.

tools.name: ash_find
tools.description: Walk a directory tree and return matching paths; respects .gitignore.

absolute.description: Emit absolute paths instead of repo-root-relative.

depth.description: Max depth; 0 is unlimited, 1 is direct children only.

exclude.description: Doublestar pattern; matching entries are skipped.

hidden.description: Include directories starting with '.' when true.

meta.description: Show type, size, and date per row; default is path only.

tools.name: ash_grep
tools.description: Search files for an RE2 pattern; skips binary and files >16 MiB.

absolute.description: Emit absolute paths instead of repo-root-relative.

ca.description: Context lines after each match; max 50.

case.description: Case sensitivity; smart is insensitive unless pattern has uppercase.

cb.description: Context lines before each match; max 50.

fo.description: Return only paths of files with at least one match.

glob.description: Doublestar pattern; scan only matching files.

hidden.description: Include directories starting with '.' when true.

lit.description: Treat pattern as literal text, not a regex.

max.description: Max total match records; hard cap 4096.

mpf.description: Max match records per file; 0 is unlimited.

no-text.description: Omit matched line text; render path:line:col only.

pattern.description: RE2 regex; literal text when lit=true.

tools.name: ash_git
tools.description: Structured git calls via --op discriminator: status, log, diff, show.

author.description: [op=log] Filter commits by author name or email substring.

bytes.description: [op=diff|show] Max patch bytes; omits patch past cap, preserves stats. Max 4 MiB.

limit.description: [op=log] Max commits to return; hard cap 200.

path.description: Any path inside the git worktree; output is repo-root-relative.

pathspec.description: [op=log|diff|show] Restrict to a path, repo-root-relative, passed after --.

ref.description: [op=show] Commit ref for show: SHA, branch, tag, HEAD~1. Required.

since.description: [op=log] Only commits after this date; accepts git --since formats.

staged.description: [op=diff] Diff index vs HEAD; default diffs worktree vs index.

stat.description: [op=diff|show] Return per-file add/delete counts only; no patch text.

tools.name: ash_write
tools.description: Write a file atomically; creates parent directories by default.

absolute.description: Emit absolute paths instead of repo-root-relative.

content.description: File content; pass '-' to read from stdin.

encoding.description: Content encoding; use base64 for binary files.

no-clobber.description: Fail with 'exists' if the file already exists.

tools.name: ash_metrics
tools.description: Query recent call history from the ledger.

verb.description: Filter to calls for a specific verb.

tools.name: ash_report
tools.description: Per-verb ledger summary: n, ok%, p50/p95 latency, tokens, trunc%.

all.description: Aggregate across every installed repo; includes per-root breakdown.

last.description: Row cap after session/since filters; max 5000.

root.description: Project root to query read-only; mutually exclusive with --all.

session.description: Session scope: current, all, or explicit session ID.

since.description: Time window (e.g. 15m, 1h, 7d); supports Go duration + d.

top.description: Max entries in truncation and error histogram sections.

verb.description: Restrict aggregation to calls for a specific verb.

tools.name: ash_help
tools.description: Return argument schema for one verb or all verbs.

verb.description: Verb name to describe; omit for all verbs.

tools.name: ash_hook
tools.description: PreToolUse decision engine; steers harness tools to ash equivalents.

path.description: Grep/Glob search root or Read path.

tools.name: ash_stat
tools.description: Return lstat metadata for one or more paths.

absolute.description: Emit absolute paths instead of repo-root-relative.

follow.description: Resolve symlinks; broken symlinks produce error=broken_symlink per entry.

path.description: Single-path alias for --paths; one of --paths or --path required.

paths.description: Comma-separated paths to inspect; one of --paths or --path required.

tools.name: ash_edit
tools.description: Atomically edit a file: string-replace, line-range, or patch mode.

absolute.description: Emit absolute paths instead of repo-root-relative.

all.description: [mode=string] Replace every occurrence; false errors if old appears multiple times.

dry.description: Compute the replacement without writing; result includes unified diff.

new.description: [mode=string] Replacement text; pass '-' to read from stdin; empty string deletes the match. / [mode=range] Replacement lines; pass '-' to read from stdin; empty string deletes the range.

old.description: [mode=string] Exact text to find; pass '-' to read from stdin; must appear once unless all=true.

patch.description: [mode=patch] Unified diff to apply; pass '-' to read from stdin.

range.description: [mode=range] start:end line range to replace, 1-based inclusive.

tools.name: ash_diff
tools.description: Unified diff: file vs file or inline content, capped at 4000 lines.

absolute.description: Emit absolute paths instead of repo-root-relative.

content.description: Inline after-side text; pass '-' to read from stdin.

stat.description: Return add/delete/unchanged counts only; no patch text.

tools.name: ash_bench
tools.description: Benchmark ash vs bash; report token/latency deltas per case.

baseline.description: Run fresh bench, compare against rolling median over the window.

case.description: Run a single named case; overrides --verb.

compare.description: Compare two persisted runs; 'latest' resolves to most recent.

diff_micro.description: Run micro bench and compare against bench/microbench.json.

export_md.description: Render latest bench run as Markdown.

limit.description: Cap cases after filters; 0 is no cap.

list.description: List recent persisted bench runs and exit.

micro.description: Run Go Benchmark* functions for curated hot-path packages.

micro_count.description: go test -count for --micro mode; 1 runs each benchmark once per benchtime window.

micro_packages.description: Comma-separated package paths for --micro; default: curated hot-path set.

record_baseline.description: Run fresh bench; write baseline.json, baseline.md, latency-snapshot.json.

record_micro.description: Run micro bench and write bench/microbench.json + bench/microbench.md.

regress_latency.description: Latency delta % threshold for regression in --compare.

regress_tokens.description: Token delta % threshold for regression in --compare.

repeat.description: Measured iterations per case; >1 enables p50 and min latency.

verb.description: Restrict to cases for one verb.

warmup.description: Unmeasured warm-up iterations; defaults to 1 when repeat>1.

tools.name: ash_test
tools.description: Run Go tests; return structured per-test results.

bench.description: go test -bench pattern; implies -run=^$ when --run is unset.

count.description: go test -count; 1 bypasses cache, 0 uses cache.

packages.description: Comma-separated package patterns for go test.

run.description: Regex for go test -run; filters tests.

timeout.description: Timeout; also passed to go test -timeout.

verbose.description: Include passing test names per package.

tools.name: ash_init
tools.description: Bootstrap a repo for ash: hook, gitignore, CLAUDE.md, registry. Idempotent.

force.description: Overwrite conflicting PreToolUse or CLAUDE.md sections.

path.description: Target repo root; default '.' is the daemon's project root.

tools.name: ash_uninit
tools.description: Reverse ash init: remove hook, gitignore entry, CLAUDE.md section, registry.

tools.name: ash_stop
tools.description: Stop the daemon cleanly (SIGTERM, 7s). Idempotent; next call auto-restarts.
